post.caption: Callas's stage jewels were crystal. A Milan workshop made Maria Callas's stage jewelry. Its crystals and imitation pearls came from Swarovski. The first piece was a crown for her La Gioconda debut. Swarovski took the workshop into its group in 1999. In 2005, the jewels went on show at London's Royal Opera House. Jewels on Stage ran at the Metropolitan Opera in 2006 and 2007. Callas had made her Met debut in 1956, singing Norma. Her last Met performances were as Tosca, in March 1965.
